title: Cylindrical object (2 parts)
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and a translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. On this new coordinate system, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Begin by creating the first loop with eight lines: start the first line at the origin and end it at zero point zero zero five six, zero; the second line from there to zero point zero zero five six, zero point zero zero zero nine; the third line to zero point zero zero zero nine, zero point zero zero zero nine; the fourth line to zero point zero zero zero nine, zero point zero two one six; the fifth line to zero point zero zero five six, zero point zero two one six; the sixth line to zero point zero zero five six, zero point zero two two five; the seventh line to zero point zero, zero point zero two two five; and the eighth line back to the origin. Apply a scaling factor of zero point zero two two five to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it with the same translation vector. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along its normal by zero point seven five units to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of zero point zero zero five six two two one eight eight nine zero five five four seven two two seven units, a width of zero point zero two two four eight eight seven five five six two two one eight eight nine zero seven units, and a height of zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0056, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0056, 0.0009) \
     .lineTo(0.0009, 0.0009) \
     .lineTo(0.0009, 0.0216) \
     .lineTo(0.0056, 0.0216) \
     .lineTo(0.0056, 0.0225) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0225) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# Note: CAD-Query does not directly support Euler angles, but we can use rotate and translate methods
# The given Euler angles (-90, 0, -90) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The translation vector is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], so no translation is needed

# Final model
r  # This will represent the final model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# C-channel profile drawn in the YZ plane (viewed from the right),
# then extruded along X for the full 0.75 length.
# Overall: Y = 0.0056, Z = 0.0225

t = 0.0015   # wall thickness
w = 0.0056   # total width (Y)
h = 0.0225   # total height (Z)

profile = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(w, 0)           # bottom flange outer edge
    .lineTo(w, t)           # bottom flange thickness
    .lineTo(t, t)           # up along web inside
    .lineTo(t, h - t)       # web inner
    .lineTo(w, h - t)       # top flange
    .lineTo(w, h)
    .lineTo(0, h)           # top flange outer edge
    .close()
)

r = profile.extrude(0.75)
